37:154.text: What is the matter with you? How do you decide?

37:156.text: Or is there for you a plain authority?

37:157.text: Then bring your Book if you are truthful!

37:158.text: And they have invented a kinship between Him and the jinn, but the jinn know well that they have indeed to appear
(i.e. they will be called to account)

37:159.text: from what they attribute unto Him!

37:160.text: Except the slaves of Allâh, whom He chooses
(for His Mercy i.e. true believers of Islâmic Monotheism who do not attribute false things unto Allâh)

37:162.text: [turn away from Him (Allâh) anyone of the believers]

37:163.text: Except those who are predestined to burn in Hell!

37:164.text: And there is not one of us

37:165.text: (for the prayers as you Muslims stand in rows for your prayers)

37:168.text: "If we had a reminder as had the men of old
(before the coming of Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم as a Messenger of Allâh)

37:169.text: "We would have indeed been the chosen slaves of Allâh

37:170.text: (i.e. in the Qur’ân and in Prophet Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم , and all that he brought, - the Divine Revelation)
, so they will come to know!

37:171.text: And, verily, Our Word has gone forth of old for Our slaves, the Messengers,

37:172.text: That they verily would be made triumphant,

37:173.text: And that Our hosts! they verily would be the victors.

37:175.text: And watch them and they shall see

37:176.text: Do they seek to hasten on Our Torment?

37:177.text: Then, when it descends in their courtyard
, evil will be the morning for those who had been warned!

37:178.text: away from them for a while,

37:179.text: And watch and they shall see

37:180.text: Glorified be your Lord, the Lord of Honour and Power!
from what they attribute unto Him!

37:181.text: And peace be on the Messengers!

37:182.text: And all the praises and thanks be to Allâh, Lord of the ‘Âlamîn
